# Assessment Overview

Supplementary assessment documents available for this report:

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md): High-level application architecture and component relationship diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md): Declared dependency inventory grouped by functional category.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md): Service catalog, endpoint inventory, and communication sequence.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md): Persistence model, ER diagram, and data ownership analysis.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md): Externalized settings, profiles, and secrets inventory.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md): Core business processes, rules, and workflow sequence.
